=== about
ypy-refresh with a selector: the element that has ypy-get is fetched again and morphed; the rest stays.
=== page
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart"><p>0 items</p></div><p id="other">same</p>
=== input
event: ypy-refresh
data: selector #cart
data: debounce 10

=== dom
<div id="cart" ypy-get="/cart"><p>2 items</p></div><p id="other">same</p>
=== respond
/cart => <p>2 items</p>
=== requests
GET /cart
